subject: PrimeBridge SIG intake, evidence onboarding, and temporary retention exception request
messages:
From: Elena Rojas <elena@primebridge.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>
Cc: PrimeBridge Procurement <procurement@primebridge.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PrimeBridge SIG intake & onboarding - initial ask

Hi Maya,

Thanks for taking this on. Attached is our standard SIG template — we need Redwood to complete sections related to SOC 2 controls, tenant/data residency, key management, and data retention for EU-origin data. Target timeline: 10 business days.

Two items we need up front so we can scope legal review:
- Confirmation of whether Redwood can sign a 90-day temporary exception to our 5-year retention clause for logs that originate in EU regions (PrimeBridge requires a legal exception to process bank PII in some flows).
- A short control mapping (CSV/xlsx) from SIG questions to Redwood evidence artifacts (SOC 2 report sections, configuration pages, log retention policies).

Can you also provide a SOC 2 snapshot (system description + control owners) and a list of exact artifact filenames we should expect? If possible, share a Drive link.

Attachment: PrimeBridge_SIG_Template_2027.xlsx (xls/xlsx)

Regards,
Elena Rojas
Head of Vendor Assurance
PrimeBridge Financial

---
Note: Procurement contact Roger Klein (roger.klein@primebridge.com) will handle contract language once we have the control mapping and retention decision.

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rojas <elena@primebridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>, PrimeBridge Procurement <procurement@primebridge.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PrimeBridge SIG intake & onboarding - initial ask

Elena — thanks, received.

We can meet the 10-business-day cadence for a first-pass delivery of the SIG control map and supporting evidence index with one ask: can you confirm which sections of the template you want treated as "high-priority" (encryption, KMS, access control, data retention)? We'll prioritize accordingly.

Planned deliverables (first pass, ~10 biz days):
- SIG control map (redwood-sig-mapping-v1.xlsx) mapping PrimeBridge questions to evidence artifacts and SOC 2 control references.
- SOC 2 snapshot (redwood-soc2-snapshot.zip) with system description, control owners, and a sampling index.
- Evidence index CSV listing artifact filenames and access instructions (evidence-index.csv).

About the temporary exception: we cannot unilaterally sign a legal retention exception. Operationally we can propose a technical workaround to minimize exposure: short-term retention window + pseudonymization of sensitive fields + proof-of-delete workflow and attestation. If PrimeBridge legal needs a contract-level exception, we'll need Roger on the thread to review proposed clause language.

Looping in Ben (security operations) and Jasmine (legal ops) to confirm artifact availability and whether we can produce a KMS provenance note specific to EU keys.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-snapshot.zip (zip), redwood-sig-mapping-v1.xlsx (xlsx)

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Head of Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 08:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PrimeBridge SIG intake & onboarding - initial ask

Maya / Jasmine — quick internal note on the retention exception ask.

Operational stance: we do not recommend a contract-level blanket exception for EU-origin logs. Instead propose this combined approach we can commit to in 10 biz days:
- Implement a scoped retention policy for PrimeBridge-origin streams: 90-day raw log retention, then automatic pseudonymization (replace PIIs with irreversible tokens) and move to long-term encrypted archive for 5 years.
- Provide attested proof-of-delete events (signed hash) for raw logs after 90 days.
- Provide a KMS provenance doc for EU keys (kms-key-provenance.md) showing ownership model and monthly rotation cadence.

Work needed from Legal: define what qualifies as "pseudonymization" for PrimeBridge; if they require full deletion we need contract-level approval. From an engineering perspective, the above is implementable without a product change.

I'll take point on assembling the KMS doc and the retention playbook; Jasmine can advise on legal language.

Ben
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Rojas <elena@primebridge.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya@redwood.ai>
Cc: PrimeBridge Procurement <procurement@primebridge.com>, Roger Klein <roger.klein@primebridge.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PrimeBridge SIG intake & onboarding - initial ask

Thanks for the quick replies and proposed workaround. PrimeBridge legal will accept a technical pseudonymization + attested-delete workflow as long as we get:
1) A formal KMS key custody note for the EU region (who holds the wrapped key, rotation schedule).
2) A short, signable amendment that documents the temporary 90-day raw retention + pseudonymization process and the attestation cadence.

Roger — can you confirm whether procurement will accept a short amendment (we prefer DocuSign) or if you need a full contract redline?

If Redwood can drop the KMS note and the SIG mapping by end of day Friday (June 4), we can route to legal and aim for signature the following week.

Elena

Subject: Re: PrimeBridge SIG intake & onboarding - initial ask

Elena / Roger — good news, attaching the first-pass artifacts and links. We expect this to address PrimeBridge's gating items for legal review.

Deliverables attached/provided:
- redwood-sig-mapping-v1.xlsx — control map mapping PrimeBridge SIG questions to SOC 2 controls and specific evidence files.
- redwood-soc2-snapshot.zip — system description, control owners, and sample testing windows.
- kms-key-provenance.md — high-level statement of key custody and rotation for EU region (we DO NOT include private key material).
- evidence-index.csv — filenames, brief descriptions, and shared Drive path.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-primebridge-evidence
DocuSign placeholder: https://app.redwood.ai/docusign/PRB-2027-0043/placeholder

Proposed amendment language (summary to insert into DocuSign):
- Scope: temporary 90-day raw log retention for EU-origin traffic for telemetry needed to diagnose and remediate incidents; after 90 days, raw logs will be pseudonymized and only indexed metadata stored for 5 years.
- Attestation: Redwood will provide quarterly attestation reports confirming the pseudonymization workflow and a signed hash of delete events.
- Term: amendment to be effective for 12 months from signature unless superseded.

Next steps:
- Ben to upload final kms-key-provenance.md by EOD Friday.
- Jasmine to produce recommended amendment text for Roger to push via DocuSign.
- Maya to confirm final evidence package availability for legal review.

Attachments: evidence-index.csv (csv)

Thanks —
Maya
Head of Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference
